reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint` cilium-agent flag (`enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint` in Helm) has been deprecated", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The flag still works in 1.17 but is deprecated; the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18, so the setting will no longer control it.
consequence.remediation: Stop setting the flag/Helm value before upgrading to v1.18.

proposed.statement: The cilium-agent flag --enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint (Helm enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint) is deprecated, and the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18.
